svg.title: A Thirty-Day Sprint to a Ready Sales Operation
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-thirty-day-launch-roadmap; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: A Thirty-Day Sprint to a Ready Sales Operation; subtitle: Build evidence, economics, and repeatable execution before scaling outreach.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Milestones represent Days 1–7, 8–14, 15–21, and 22–30; numeric_value records each milestone's ending day. This sprint prepares the operating system and early pipeline. Canonical time to first deal remains 3–12 months.; caption: Finish the month with a narrow product thesis, reconciled economics, a tested delivery workflow, and accountable prospect follow-up rather than an assumed closed sale.; stages: label: Days 1–7; value: Choose one product family and verify channel access; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Select a buyer segment, request vendor authorization, map CPPO or CSP participation requirements, identify required certifications, and document unresolved eligibility items before making customer-facing resale claims.; label: Days 8–14; value: Build quote economics and settlement controls; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Create a versioned quote template and vendor-cost ledger. Reconcile $1,400,000 gross billings to $196,000 owner net in the Base model; stress-test delayed collections against the startup cash allocation.; label: Days 15–21; value: Test implementation and automate recurring account work; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Use an authorized demonstration tenant to test entitlement reconciliation, acceptance evidence, access removal, quote generation, and renewal alerts. Obtain contractor scopes with explicit effort limits and change-order pricing.; label: Days 22–30; value: Launch targeted discovery and review operating evidence; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Research the initial 100-account cohort, begin relevant outreach, and record actual stage movement without assuming the annual funnel converts this month. Review authorization status, cash exposure, delivery readiness, and each opportunity's next dated action.

rect.title: label: Days 8–14; value: Build quote economics and settlement controls; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Create a versioned quote template and vendor-cost ledger. Reconcile $1,400,000 gross billings to $196,000 owner net in the Base model; stress-test delayed collections against the startup cash allocation.

rect.title: label: Days 15–21; value: Test implementation and automate recurring account work; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Use an authorized demonstration tenant to test entitlement reconciliation, acceptance evidence, access removal, quote generation, and renewal alerts. Obtain contractor scopes with explicit effort limits and change-order pricing.
